title: Figure 6. Atlas IIAS Breakup Percentages for Random-Attitude Turns
description: Line graph of "Breakup Percent (%)" versus "Failure Time (sec)" (0 to 280) for q-alpha values of 5,000, 10,000 and 20,000 deg-lb/ft^2. Breakup rises to near 100% between about 40 and 120 seconds, then drops to zero by about 165 seconds. It sits within section 6.2, "Shaping Constants for Atlas IIAS," on optimum Mode-5 shaping constants.
